en.summary: Fixes sampler datapath bugs so runtime filter selection and per-texel channel formatting produce the correct sampled color.
why_it_counts: All substantive changes are inside texture-sampler RTL modules.
The patch changes functional sampling behavior, including runtime selection between point and bilinear results and channel masking per texel.
The commit message explicitly calls these sampler bug fixes.
disqualifiers: Some edits also repair packed-array declarations and module-local syntax, so the bug bundle is broader than a single one-line fix.
evidence: VX_tex_sampler.v removes the old top-level point-versus-bilinear branch and instead always computes per-thread bilerp output, then selects req_texels[i][0] or req_data_bilerp[i] with a runtime req_filter mux.
VX_tex_format.v fixes the formatted_texel_r declaration to [NUM_TEXELS-1:0][63:0] and applies the 64-bit channel mask separately to each texel element.
VX_tex_bilerp.v changes color_enable to NUM_COLOR_CHANNEL bits and uses explicit per-channel checks when constructing sampled_data.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix corrects two closely related sampler mechanisms: selecting the proper filter datapath at runtime, and applying channel formatting or masking at the granularity of each texel and color channel. If a texture unit hardwires the wrong filter path, or applies a mask to a packed multi-texel vector instead of to each texel element, some filter modes and formats will return malformed colors even though the memory fetch itself succeeded.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: texture filter-path selection and per-texel channel formatting
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Sampling requests use different filter modes at runtime, especially bilinear filtering or packed RGB formats where multiple texels are reformatted and blended.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Break the runtime mux between point and bilinear datapaths or flatten per-texel channel masking into one packed-vector operation.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: break runtime filter mux and flatten per-texel mask
portability_notes: Map this to any texture or image-sampling datapath that has multiple filter modes and format-conversion logic before blending.
The important bug is wrong structural granularity: selecting one filter path at elaboration time or masking a whole packed vector instead of each texel independently.
If only one analogue is desired on another DUT, prefer the runtime filter-selection fault because it directly changes which sampled result is returned.
concrete_injection_steps: Remove or bypass the runtime mux that selects between point-sample output and filtered output, so one path is effectively forced or selected using the wrong structural condition.
Apply any channel-enable or format mask to an entire packed texel bundle instead of iterating over each texel element and channel separately.
Allow the color-enable bus width or interpretation to mismatch the actual number of color channels so the wrong channels are gated.
Leave the memory fetch path intact so the fault manifests as a wrong sampled color rather than a fetch miss.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Sampler filter selection, texel format conversion, and bilerp channel gating
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit restructures VX_tex_sampler around a runtime req_filter mux, fixes per-texel formatting in VX_tex_format, and aligns color_enable handling in VX_tex_bilerp with the actual channel count.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the texture sampler path, remove the final req_filter runtime mux or force it to the wrong side, and in VX_tex_format revert from per-texel masking back to one packed-vector mask on the formatted texel bundle.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Point-filtered and bilinear texture requests can return the wrong path's result, or sampled colors can have malformed channel values and alpha behavior for some formats.
evidence_for_injection: The fixed sampler now computes bilerp data for every thread and selects it with a runtime req_filter mux, which directly exposes the previous path-selection problem.
The fixed formatter applies the mask to each texel element separately, showing that a wide packed operation was previously wrong.
The fixed bilerp module aligns color_enable width with NUM_COLOR_CHANNEL, tying the bug to channel-level gating rather than to memory access.
notes: This commit bundles multiple sampler fixes; a practical single-fault reinjection should prefer the runtime filter-select bug or the per-texel mask bug, not necessarily both at once.
Do not use the whitespace-only changes in VX_tex_memory.v or VX_tex_unit.v as injection anchors.

zh.summary: 该修复解决了 sampler 数据通路中的功能错误，使运行时滤波路径选择与逐 texel 的通道格式化都能产生正确采样颜色。
why_it_counts: 所有实质性改动都位于纹理采样 RTL 模块内部。
补丁改变了功能性采样行为，包括运行时在 point 与 bilinear 结果之间选择，以及对每个 texel 的通道掩码处理。
提交信息明确说明这是 sampler bug fixes。
disqualifiers: 部分修改也修正了 packed-array 声明和模块局部语法，因此这是一组 bug，而不是单一一行修复。
evidence: VX_tex_sampler.v 删除了旧的顶层 point 与 bilinear 分支，改为始终为每个线程计算 bilerp 输出，再通过运行时 req_filter mux 在 req_texels[i][0] 和 req_data_bilerp[i] 之间选择。
VX_tex_format.v 把 formatted_texel_r 的声明修正为 [NUM_TEXELS-1:0][63:0]，并把 64 位通道掩码分别作用到每个 texel 元素上。
VX_tex_bilerp.v 把 color_enable 的位宽改为 NUM_COLOR_CHANNEL，并在生成 sampled_data 时使用显式逐通道判断。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复同时纠正了两个紧密相关的 sampler 机制：一是运行时选择正确的滤波数据通路，二是按每个 texel 和每个颜色通道的粒度执行格式化与掩码。如果纹理单元把错误的滤波路径硬连线，或者把通道掩码施加到打包后的多 texel 向量而不是逐 texel 元素施加，那么即便内存读取成功，某些滤波模式和格式仍会返回畸形颜色。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 纹理滤波路径选择与逐 texel 通道格式化
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 采样请求在运行时切换不同滤波模式，尤其是使用 bilinear filtering 或需要对多个 texel 进行格式化与混合的打包 RGB 格式。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 破坏 point 与 bilinear 数据通路之间的运行时 mux，或把逐 texel 的通道掩码错误地扁平化为对整个打包向量的一次操作。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 破坏运行时滤波 mux，并把逐 texel 掩码扁平化
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在混合之前需要执行格式转换、且支持多种滤波模式的纹理或图像采样数据通路。
关键错误是结构粒度不对：在 elaboration 时就固定滤波路径，或者对整个打包向量施加掩码，而不是逐 texel 独立处理。
如果在另一套 DUT 上只注入一种同类故障，优先选择运行时滤波选择错误，因为它最直接改变最终返回的采样结果。
concrete_injection_steps: 移除或绕过运行时在 point-sample 输出与 filtered 输出之间进行选择的 mux，使其中一条路径被错误固定或以错误条件被选中。
把 channel-enable 或 format mask 从逐 texel、逐通道处理，改成对整个打包 texel 束的一次整体操作。
让 color-enable 总线的位宽或解释方式与实际颜色通道数不匹配，从而错误屏蔽或放行通道。
保持内存取数路径不变，使故障表现为错误颜色，而不是取数失败。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Sampler 中的滤波选择、texel 格式转换和 bilerp 通道门控
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 VX_tex_sampler 重构为运行时 req_filter mux，修复了 VX_tex_format 中逐 texel 的格式化掩码，并让 VX_tex_bilerp 中的 color_enable 处理与真实通道数保持一致。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在纹理采样路径中，去掉最终的 req_filter 运行时 mux 或强制其选到错误一侧，并在 VX_tex_format 中把逐 texel 掩码回退成对整个 formatted texel bundle 的一次整体掩码。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: point-filtered 或 bilinear 的纹理请求可能返回错误路径的结果，或者在某些格式下出现通道值与 alpha 行为异常的采样颜色。
evidence_for_injection: 修复后的 sampler 现在会为每个线程始终计算 bilerp 数据，并通过运行时 req_filter mux 选择，这直接暴露了先前的路径选择问题。
修复后的 formatter 把掩码分别作用到每个 texel 元素，说明原先对宽打包向量的一次操作是错误的。
修复后的 bilerp 模块把 color_enable 位宽与 NUM_COLOR_CHANNEL 对齐，表明缺陷发生在通道级门控，而不是内存访问。
notes: 该提交包含多个 sampler 修复；如果只注入一个实际故障，优先选择运行时滤波选择错误或逐 texel 掩码错误之一。
不要把 VX_tex_memory.v 和 VX_tex_unit.v 中仅有的空白变化作为注入锚点。
